notes.title: Dissociated Update Event
notes.content:
*Victim Game Version Update 2.2+ Only Available for the Windows OS 

Game Version 2.2.0.0

-All of the Bosses now have a new updated look in a pixel based style to be more cohesive with the surrounding environments. 

-Added a guide to assist within the early game's purgatory maze to reduce player confusion.

-Now the Brick attack to shoots in the direction the player is facing and at a lower angle. Instead of the prior intrinsic precision mechanic which is now gone.

-Adjusted the Murder Crow threat to behave in a better hit and run way, rather than the prior thrashing of claws and wings.

-Adjusted the Doll Face threat and removed it's prior movement pattern and replaced it with a wave type movement function that moves toward and faces the direction of the player.

-Replaced all the prior Background Gradients with new stylized pixelated gradients and brighter colors.

-Replaced all of the Cutscenes with pixelated styled animation frames that are cohesively similar to one another.

-Replaced all text prompts with sprites and replaced the prior in game font to match all in game text with a few exceptions.

-Replaced the eyes threats and ghost threat sprites with new sprites.

-Replaced most of the tree sprites with new sprites.

-Replaced most of the menu selection sprites

-Replaced a bunch of Backgrounds with newer versions

-and more.

-Adjusted Ladders in the sewer area.

-Updated all of the Game's Steam Achievement icons and added one new achievement.

-Replaced a ton of menu sprites with refined cohesive sprite style to fit in more with the aesthetics.

-Replaced the control page menu back.

-replaced the all of the mountain backgrounds.

-replaced the sprites that did not mesh with the aesthetics with newer more fitting sprites.

-Fixed the Ladder positions on the left side wall of the First Horrors Tower.

-Fixed a bug in the Horrors where the wrong husk spawned toward solving a puzzle after the initial husk disintegrated and forced the player to solve the puzzle first try.  
This has been corrected to spawn the correct husk after each initial husk dissolves.

-Fixed a bug in the Checklist where the "Defeat Omninumb" box was checked before the Omninumb Boss has been defeated.

-and more.
